caption:
You think your habits are your own. Research says your partner has a lot to do with them.

A UCL study of more than 3,700 couples found people were more likely to make a healthy change when their partner made it too.

It works both ways: the late-night scrolling and the Friday takeaway spread just as easily as the walks.

Who's the healthier one in your relationship? Tag them.

Save this for date night, and send it to your other half.

#CouplesGoals #HealthyCouple #RelationshipsUK #HealthyHabitsUK #UKWellness
